spots.name: Delano Peak
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 3,710 m (12,173 ft).

spots.name: Minersville Reservoir: South Side
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 226 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L591911.

spots.name: Minersville Reservoir
spots.tip: A lake: calm air at dawn gives mirror reflections, and mist often sits on the water on cold mornings. Pin moved to Minersville Reservoir: South Side on the shore.
